positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer II (L62)
positions.description:
I've owned and delivered high-impact initiatives across Microsoft's Windows servicing and delivery — collaborating with engineers, program managers, and product managers across multiple teams to drive results end-to-end, from design to production.

- Migrated a core validation service to a more secure, compliant tenant — a major security milestone that reduced attack surface, and aligned it with company-wide compliance standards. Coordinated across multiple engineering and PM stakeholders to own the full execution and cutover plan.

- Drove a collaborative effort to make the security package validation service faster and more resilient:
	1) Modernized from legacy on-prem to cloud-native, eliminating critical single points of failure — and cutting end-to-end validation time by ~17%.
	2) Designed and led the development of a signal-driven early validation system with cross-functional teams, proactively triggering package validation based on upstream signals to further reduce overall end-to-end validation time.

- Expanded validation coverage by onboarding multiple new Windows products to the service, establishing the first automated quality gate for their releases — delivered independently under tight timelines.

- Partnered with multiple engineering teams to onboard them onto the validation infrastructure, enabling them to independently own the testing and validation of their Windows update packages — reducing dependency bottlenecks, improving release confidence.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: Drove key capability expansions in Expedia's Conversation Platform, engineering enhancements to the Twilio-based voice adapter to enable seamless Virtual Agent interactions over voice — including IVR, multi-language support, and emergency messaging — as part of the company's global Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) modernization strategy. The platform handles 72.5M+ voice conversations across global call centers, with 17% resolved via self-service, generating $11M+ in annual savings.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description: Membership and Subscriptions Team responsible for core subscription services for Amazon Prime, Alexa Voice, Echo, Kindle Unlimited, Music, Videos, Audible, and many major Amazon businesses. — ensuring seamless, uninterrupted experiences for millions of customers at scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Student Programs-Engineering)
positions.description:
•Developed scripts to autoconfigure Linux hosts storage, networking and rpm installation
•Created ansible playbooks to autoconfigure physical volumes, volume groups and logical volumes for storage
•Created a two-factor authentication proxy for ssh user logins using duo, Active Directory and nslcd 
•Created a Python application which provides rest API for configuration backups in all the Production servers
•Provided technical support for Motorola’s Push-to-talk application by troubleshooting at various OSI layers
•Created scripts and ansible playbooks to automate redundant deployment activities
•Responsible for developing, testing and maintaining Java client application using SPRING Boot, REST, XML, JSON, JAX-WS, Maven to consume Motorola’s SOAP services to automate testing
•Developed front end application using Angular, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript to interact with the Motorola’s
SOAP services
•Created a container image for the service and implement consul for service discovery

projects.title: Fitness Application
projects.description:
Designed and developed in iOS 8 using Objective C
Developed using CoreMotion, M7/M8 co-processor
Designed interface which displays number of steps walked by user and displays real time count of the number of steps
Displays the current activity of the user (still, walking, running, cycling, driving)

projects.title: Heartbeat Monitor
projects.description:
Designed and developed in iOS 8 using Objective C, C++
Designed and improvised the algorithm to detect the heartbeat using OpenCV
OpenCV was used to detect the user’s face (from front camera) and using it to get the heartbeats
Also used the video of user’s finger(with flash on) to sense the redness of the finger and measuring that redness to get the coarse estimate of individual’s heartbeat
